prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that 2025 trip when I ended up bouncing between Beijing and Shanghai for a bit.
Shanghai itself was fun though—back then I even kept a little list of attractions in Shanghai so we wouldn’t waste time wandering around.
For the train part, my friend had already booked it ages ago: D321 on 2025-03-02, Second Class, and it was under Zhang Wei.
And yeah, the passenger name on that ticket was Zhang Wei—still cracks me up how organized he was about it.
Later that month we did Shanghai Disneyland too—Li Na had already handled the tickets for 2025-03-24, morning slot, 5 of us.
